mintAuthority.summary: Commission-operated role holders can mint native liabilities on seven EVM-compatible deployments, including Hedera, and through the Solana Token-2022 mint authority. UUPS upgraders can replace EVM issuance rules. Fireblocks HSM custody is disclosed, but full live membership and signing independence are not verified.

controls.evidence: Finalized getMultipleAccounts context slot 453519819 re-verifies W3R03's approved Token-2022 identity: exact FRNT mint authority DsRa7mCpCfcTxdNJvaTzbRe73FuBbrs8U8NEAxFunWnr is non-executable, owned by TokenzQdBNbLqP5VEhdkAS6EPFLC1PHnBqCXEpPxuEb, and an initialized native multisig requiring one of two signers: 7VhCbqKQEz3RNLSuAuiRmBVEVWdgcFqGHMiVPPo2KjHy and G15NrcKeqQoPG5ERcTLN1SNWZWv7BqbjvnnyQ1vJyAKf. The first signer account is absent and the second is a non-executable system account. Native multisig account data has no module or guard mechanism; this is not a custom executable controller. The same response includes the distinct scaled-UI authority 3FL7iZaerXVygpPAFtXyxoCGdoUt11eiSBYkko6mMD8x, multiplier 1, and the Token-2022 program and ProgramData account. Cryptographic topology does not establish operator independence, private key custody, recovery policy, historical incident attribution or complete program execution reach.

review.evidence: Prior W2R23 complete RoleGranted/RoleRevoked history from genesis remains pinned to October 3 blocks Ethereum 26110208, Avalanche 96655718, Base 52110947, Polygon 94870735, Arbitrum 511231213 and Optimism 157706232. All six identified sole DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE 0x5e3372f9a1c04e789ef86df9ec35f87e000bb15b, sole UPGRADER_ROLE 0x7f6cc8151ac948429911dab959d9e305501079ba, issuer MINTER_ROLE 0x83465b1bac70dc63c0d6b72e9f012af4a1e7138a and a chain-local CCIP pool minter; admin/upgrader membership was corroborated by pinned hasRole. Verified ERC20F._authorizeUpgrade is UPGRADER_ROLE-only with no contract delay. Prior Hedera census retrieved 85 logs through Unix second 1791071400 with links.next=null, reconstructing those same issuer roles plus minter 0xb9e7e53ad3f4bbc352a55c33db7bcf25e0da3f03. R02 re-verifies W3R03's BurnMintTokenPool 1.6.1 identity and enumerates its seven remote configurations, both directional rate buckets, router, RMN proxy, owner and router off-ramps at one mirror block 100747953; these view observations are not executable-source correspondence or full mutable permission closure. R02 finalized Solana slot 453519819 re-verifies the approved Token-2022 one-of-two native mint multisig and separate scaled-UI authority. The provider's primary September 14 response now supplies a historical receipt: finalized slot 424090107, June 3 2026 19:29:21 UTC, changes only scaledUiAmount authority on exact FRNT, with no mint, burn or mint-authority-change instruction. This dates the display-authorization transfer, not the Commission CISO's separately worded private-key allegation or a mint incident resolution. Searched current Commission technology, news and meeting bundles, January 14 cryptographic-management rules, CISO disclosure, provider response, official August 2025 audit archive and rekt.news coverage. No independently mapped active/resolved native-mint incident or incident-free finding is asserted. Signer independence, custody and recovery policy remain undisclosed; public required procedures do not prove deployed enforcement. Existing TNF FRNT dashboard evidence identifies issued AT-C 205 examinations, a daily archive through October 3 and independently collected circulating balances/daily Fiduciary Trust statements, supporting attestation-only issuer oversight, not prudential licensing or a reviewed report opinion. Signed reports were not retrieved by this control review; reconciliation remains unknown. Every prior controller and adverse mint/upgrade fact is preserved, with incomplete aggregate review explicit.
review.reviewer: W2R23 authority census; W3R03 authenticated identity review; R02 exact historical receipt and pinned Hedera reach narrowing
unresolvedQuestions: At mirror block 100747953 the additional Hedera minter 0xb9e7e53ad3f4bbc352a55c33db7bcf25e0da3f03 returns BurnMintTokenPool 1.6.1 and exact FRNT getToken. Its seven remote token/pool entries, enabled inbound/outbound buckets, owner 0x5e3372f9a1c04e789ef86df9ec35f87e000bb15b, router 0x87b400b4d4f5fe2fdb6fbea66c38003ced565b76 and RMN proxy 0x09d9c9a2ba147654fb40e217b68f2874775271b9 are enumerated. Router getOffRamps returns 14 entries and owner 0x04c632720dd676e1443a93a52ac919c236866ea9. Public view results do not certify executable correspondence or close mutable router/off-ramp and permission-change reach; Sourcify v2 has no verified match and the files endpoint returns 403. Native-versus-transfer liability reach remains unresolved.

Solana mint authority remains an initialized Token-2022 one-of-two multisig at finalized slot 453519819. Which independently evidenced operator and recovery policies govern signer keys 7VhCbqKQEz3RNLSuAuiRmBVEVWdgcFqGHMiVPPo2KjHy and G15NrcKeqQoPG5ERcTLN1SNWZWv7BqbjvnnyQ1vJyAKf, and how does that cryptographic quorum relate to Chapter 2's required multiple-signer operating procedures?

Finalized transaction 4D3VgoF9YjFh6LXkuvPu5aK5aL3yuxUMiSuwHqRBHJvgGKAW7gnjDQ6gHkvBBxNVHbDFYMaw1V952fDX7u5F3atg at slot 424090107, June 3 2026 19:29:21 UTC, transfers only scaledUiAmount authority from DLP5sGaLm596Fa8PCNPYNofFK1cZxzME7csK3xBsABCT to 3FL7iZaerXVygpPAFtXyxoCGdoUt11eiSBYkko6mMD8x; it has no mint, burn or mint-authority-change instruction. The provider calls this the disputed authorization; the Commission CISO does not identify the affected key or transaction in its September 14 disclosure. Does the Commission's separate critical-private-key allegation refer to this same display authority or another production control, and what exact incident/resolution evidence applies? This receipt is not a resolved mint incident or incident-free aggregate review.
